message.content: The agent installed git, openssh-server, and nginx on Ubuntu 24.04, created an unlocked `user` account, a bare repo at /git/server with a post-receive hook deploying to /var/www/html, configured nginx on port 8080, started sshd, added `server` to /etc/hosts, verified clone/commit/push/curl end-to-end, then cleaned the repo and web root and set a system git identity.
